en.t: I told you about it before, didn't I?

units.source_text: 那就是我同你爹结婚，以及你还是个可爱的婴儿，我同你爹把你抱走的时候。

en.t: It was when I married your father, and when you were still a sweet little baby, and your father and I carried you away.

units.source_text: 就是我们把你抢来，坐车逃跑的时候啊！

en.t: It was when we snatched you up and fled by car!

units.source_text: 虽然已经过去二十年了，如今回想起来，心里还是扑通扑通地跳呢。

en.t: Even though twenty years have already passed, when I think back on it now, my heart still pounds.

units.source_text: 千重子，你按按妈妈的胸口试试看。”

en.t: Chieko, try pressing your hand against your mother's chest.
